work.title: The Parent Trap
work.note: The Parent Trap é um filme de 1961 (com versão nova em 1998) sobre duas gêmeas que se conhecem num acampamento de verão. Na aula, o Dan chega a um acampamento e a Tina diz: “We’re going to have a lot of fun.” A cena desta aula é original; não reproduz a obra.

pages.title: A summer camp · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot Sunday in July at a summer camp near Miami. Green trees stand around a big lake. Tina waits at the camp gate with a list. A new boy named Dan comes with his bag. Other kids play near the water. Tina says hello with a big smile.
“Welcome to camp, Dan! How long are you going to stay?” says Tina. “I’m going to stay for two weeks.” says Dan. “Great! We’re going to have a lot of fun.” says Tina.
